text:
sanjay: Heads up — big eviction spike in us-east1 after a cross-AZ network blip ~02:15 UTC. Multiple GPU nodes reported pod evictions in waves.

devin: Confirmed. Saw autoscaler kill a couple underutilized nodes, scheduler then crushed remaining GPU capacity into a few racks -> fragmentation + preemptions.

maria: Do we have correlation with node-probe failures or kubelet network errors?

sanjay: Yes — kubelet logs show repeated ‘NetworkUnavailable’ and probe timeouts. Scheduler logs: "FailedScheduling: InsufficientTopology" during the flood. Quick paste of one node state:

```
# kubectl get pods -o wide --field-selector spec.nodeName=gpu-24
NAME                     READY   STATUS    RESTARTS   NODE    NOMINATED NODE   READINESS GATES
inference-replica-0      0/1     Evicted   0          gpu-24   <none>            <none>
batch-encode-7           0/1     Evicted   0          gpu-24   <none>            <none>
inference-replica-1      1/1     Running   0          gpu-24   <none>            <none>
```

lia: ops-bot alerted that node-probe failures spiked in us-east1-a for ~15s, then GCE marked networking unstable.

devin: Short-term mitigations: 1) make GPU inference pods prefer spreading across zones via topologySpreadConstraints; 2) reduce node-autoscaler aggressiveness so we don't drain multiple nodes in response to short-term perceived underutilization.

maria: Also consider pinning critical inference replicas to dedicated GPU pools with nodeAffinity so they don't get packed with batch jobs.

sanjay: Agreed. I'm going to: 
- bump cluster-autoscaler scale-down-unneeded-time to 20m for affected pools,
- add a soft constraint to scheduler to avoid packing >2 GPU-serving containers per rack during recovery,
- tag batch pools with taint batch=dedicated:PreferNoSchedule for a trial.

ops-bot: @sanjay change submitted: infra/PR#3742 (autoscaler tuning + taint labelling). Canary deploy scheduled in 10m. :rocket:

kube-scheduler-bot: Added metric request: `gpu_packing_ratio` (new) and alert if >0.8 for 10m. Will roll to staging.

devin: Can we also run a binpack-sim job with a simulated 20s cross-AZ partition to validate eviction counts drop?

maria: I'll notify support for possible customer impact and start collecting affected request IDs. :thumbsup:

sanjay: Thanks — will post follow-up after canary. If this lands, plan a runbook update to avoid tight packing during network instability.
